# DigiDollarStats

> Independent, real-time statistics for DigiDollar ($DD) — the decentralized USD
> stablecoin native to the DigiByte (DGB) blockchain. All figures are read live
> from the chain via the public digibyte.io API. This is a community project and
> is NOT an official DigiByte channel. Nothing here is financial advice.

## What DigiDollar is

DigiDollar ($DD) is a decentralized, over-collateralized USD stablecoin built
directly into the DigiByte UTXO protocol — not a smart contract or a bridge.
Users mint DD by locking their own DGB as collateral in DigiByte Core; the debt
is fixed in USD. There is no central issuer. Supply began at exactly zero at
mainnet activation and grows only as users mint. DGB is self-custodied the whole
time — there are no margin calls or forced liquidations. Prices come from a
distributed community oracle network (up to 35 oracles; a 7-of-35 MuSig2 quorum
signs each on-chain price bundle).

## Live data

The current DigiDollar figures — circulating supply, DGB locked as collateral,
active positions, system collateral ratio, minting status, and oracle price —
are shown live on the pages below, updated every 60 seconds directly from the
DigiByte chain via the public digibyte.io API.

## Pages

- [Home / dashboard](https://digidollarstats.com/): live supply, DGB locked,
  positions, system health, and oracle price.
- [Live stats](https://digidollarstats.com/live): minimal live dashboard of the
  same on-chain figures.
- [Oracle Watch](https://digidollarstats.com/oracle): the DigiDollar price feed
  in the open — consensus DGB/USD price, which oracles are reporting, and the
  quorum signing each price bundle onto the chain.
- [Mint calculator](https://digidollarstats.com/calculator): compare the 10 lock
  durations (1 hour to 10 years), the collateral ratio each requires, DGB needed
  per $DD, and the unlock date.
- [Run a node](https://digidollarstats.com/node): minimum specs and exact steps
  to run DigiByte Core (Windows, macOS, Linux, Raspberry Pi), which is required
  to mint and redeem DigiDollar.

## Key facts

- Ticker: $DD. Chain: DigiByte ($DGB). Network: mainnet.
- Decentralized, over-collateralized, non-custodial. No central issuer.
- Circulating supply started at zero and is minted by users locking DGB.
- Debt is fixed in USD; no margin calls or forced liquidations.
- Lock durations range from 1 hour to 10 years; longer locks require less
  collateral per dollar minted.
- Data source: digibyte.io public API. Verify independently.
